1.explanation: All of the focus‐handling in NumberPicker lives in its onFocus, onBlur and setFocus methods, and the render method applies classes to show/hide triggers based on component state. Currently triggers are shown only on hover or when alwaysShowTrigger is true, and onBlur of the internal input immediately clears the focus state (hiding the triggers). To fix this, onFocus/onBlur (or setFocus) need adjustments so that focusing any child keeps a "focused" class on the root, and the main.scss (imported via style.js) should be extended to display the up/down buttons when the wrapper matches :focus-within, in addition to hover.
1.bug_scenario: When you tab into the NumberPicker input, the up/down trigger buttons stay hidden and the component’s focus style is lost. Pressing tab again moves focus onto the (still hidden) trigger buttons and removes the focus outline. The desired behavior is to show the trigger buttons and retain the focus style on the whole NumberPicker whenever any part of it (input or buttons) has keyboard focus (e.g. via CSS :focus-within).

2.explanation: The NumberPicker class is the core component that renders the input and trigger buttons. The onFocus and onBlur methods call setFocus to update the component’s focus state, which in turn should add a CSS class (or state) to make the triggers visible when focused. The render method applies those classes to show/hide triggers and style the wrapper. The style file (main.scss imported via style.js) defines the CSS rules for showing triggers on hover but not on focus; it needs to be updated to include :focus-within or a focus class. Therefore, editing onFocus, onBlur, setFocus, render, and the style definitions will fix the visibility and focus-style issues.
2.bug_scenario: When the NumberPicker input is focused via keyboard (Tab), the up/down trigger buttons are hidden instead of being displayed. Pressing Tab again focuses the (invisible) buttons but they remain hidden, and the NumberPicker loses its focus styling. The desired behavior is that focusing any part of NumberPicker should show the trigger buttons and preserve the focus style on the wrapper (using :focus-within).
